messages:
ashley: Quick q — who is authorized to trigger the circuit-breaker for model-serving lane-3? I need to stop a canary that's spiking 5xxs in eu-west-1.
ben: Oncall or eng-platform ops. We have the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/circuit-breaker — follow the 'canary disable' section. :thumbsup:
maria: Can you confirm scope: full lane or just the canary audience? If it's just 2% canary we should flip the flag, not teardown infra.
ashley: It's the 2% canary to v3.2 in eu-west-1 — error-rate jumped ~12% over baseline since 60s ago. Want to disable canary only.
ben: Preferred flow: oncall runs the feature-flag change so audit logs are attached automatically. Command we use in prod console/cli:
```
ffz set rollout.lane3.canary false --who=@oncall --note="auto-disable: 5xx spike" --audit
```
That will route traffic back to v3.1 per fallback policy.
sre-oncall: I can flip it now. Per runbook only oncall leads, eng-platform SREs, or a product exec may flip prod circuit-breakers. After flip I will create an incident note and tag #incidents and product.
devbot: Action recorded: audit_id=cb-20260317-019; actor=sre-oncall; change="rollout.lane3.canary=false"; timestamp=1812345684
maria: After flip, please monitor these dashboards: /dashboards/model-serving/errors, /dashboards/latency/lane3. If error-rate drops to baseline and latencies stable, we can re-enable as a smaller canary and ramp.
ben: Guardrails reminder: do not delete the canary cluster. Only flip the feature flag. If there is data loss risk escalate >pager duty.
ashley: Noted. Will wait for sre-oncall to confirm action and then follow with postmortem bullet points.
sre-oncall: Flipped the flag at 1812345684. Audit id cb-20260317-019. Notifying #incidents and eng-platform. Reversion plan: re-enable to 0.5% then 2% after 1h of stability.
ashley: Thanks — tagging product ( @maria ) and ops. I'll attach logs and the PR that introduced the flag to the incident later. :white_check_mark:
ben: Also add a one-line changelog entry in the release notes so compliance has a trace: "CB disabled for lane3 canary in eu-west-1 — audit cb-20260317-019".
maria: Good call. I'll draft the postmortem notes once we have metrics.
